sonnet5.definition: support of a sentence = how many of the local judges' 10 readings (scout k=0..4, qwen k=0..4) placed evidence on it. The baseline is the mean over every sentence with support >= 1 on the same pairs; sentences no local reading touched have support 0 and are inside the picked mean but outside the baseline by construction.
